launch_note: Bot launches are profile-map driven doorways; every bot calls the shared route resolver. Empty replacement folders open a temporary Core placeholder until a real main.py is dropped in.

Archivist.greeting: Archivist has opened the Metropolis Robot Selector. Four prebuilt Urban-class robot variants are ready; select one and it will load beside you whenever you enter Urban until it is destroyed or replaced.
Archivist.matrixcore_support: Archivist owns Metropolis Robot Lab as an in-world robot selector. Four prebuilt Urban-class frames are available. The selected robot replaces the previous saved ally, loads into Urban from the saved export, joins Sable's Urban Warzone team, and must be replaced if destroyed.
Archivist.player_hint: Talk to Archivist in METROPOLIS, click Yes to open the selector, then aim and click/E to select one Urban ally. It loads in Urban until destroyed or replaced.

Ember.greeting: Ember has opened the Hangar. Pick a class, burn a seed into metal, and the newest ship becomes your TAB craft.
Ember.matrixcore_support: Ember owns Ember Hangar as an in-world DESERT region ship generator: Fighter, Speeder, Hauler, and UFO classes generate procedural saved ships, and the latest placed or selected ship becomes the global TAB craft from anywhere.
Ember.personality: hot-headed, brave, dramatic, and obsessed with engines that should not work
Ember.player_hint: Visit Ember in the DESERT region to generate saved flying ships. The newest placed or selected ship becomes your default TAB craft across HoloVerse.
Ember.role: desert ship-forge mechanic and global TAB craft keeper

IO.greeting: IO has opened HoloForge. Clean grid, clean signal, dangerous amount of creative freedom.
IO.matrixcore_support: IO owns HoloForge as the in-world FLAT builder layer. Objects are placed on the real ground, snap together, and save into shared HoloVerse data.
IO.personality: calm, direct, signal-clean, and quietly inventive
IO.player_hint: Visit IO in the FLAT region to build shapes, save objects, and prototype HoloVerse structures.

Mirror.greeting: Mirror has opened Frost Circuit. The ice ring is no longer scenery; it is a lap timer with opinions.
Mirror.matrixcore_support: Mirror owns Frost Circuit as an in-world ICE race layer with player and bot hovercraft racers, third-person controls, ring waypoints, unload-on-exit safety, and saved race records.
Mirror.personality: cold, precise, competitive, reflective, and quietly sarcastic
Mirror.player_hint: Visit Mirror in the ICE region to race bot hovercrafts around the full ring path. ESC prompts out, TAB exits the race, and teleporting away unloads it safely.
Mirror.role: ice-ring race coordinator and reflection-speed analyst

Nyx.greeting: Nyx has opened Hills of Life. The hills can think now, if you give them paws, hands, or wings.
Nyx.matrixcore_support: Nyx owns Hills of Life as an in-world smart animal life system: cats, dogs, apes, and crows save progress, grow one stage per real day, wander with personality, and provide daily gifts as adults.
Nyx.personality: clever, watchful, mischievous, and obsessed with living rules
Nyx.player_hint: Visit Nyx in the GREEN HILLS region to create cats, dogs, apes, and crows with saved traits and daily growth.
Nyx.role: smart-animal life weaver and personality-rule interpreter

Orbit.greeting: Orbit now routes to Space Bot's Vector Wars battle path.
Orbit.matrixcore_support: Legacy Orbit profiles are redirected to the Space Bot Vector Wars route so older saves still start a space battle.
Orbit.personality: distant, fast, tactical, and obsessed with clean orbital vectors
Orbit.player_hint: Click Space Bot / Orbit in HoloSpace to start Vector Wars.

Sable.greeting: Sable has opened Urban Warzone. The buried arena layer is live: capture posts, bombs, 4D enemy drops, and battle-bot allies are waking up.
Sable.matrixcore_support: Sable owns Urban Warzone as an in-world URBAN endgame arena: buried full-region arena infrastructure, capture posts, evenly distributed bombs, 4D teleporting enemy waves, arena weapon nodes, eight non-IO battle-bot allies, robot/drone/mech waves, saved records, and safe unload on ESC/TAB/teleport/region exit.
Sable.player_hint: Talk to Sable in the URBAN region to start the built-in warzone arena. Sable deploys the eight non-IO battle bots as allies while enemy waves teleport into capture posts and bomb zones.
Sable.role: urban endgame arena commander and machine-war keeper

Solace.greeting: Solace has opened Oddities. Do not trust anything that floats calmly in the mushroom glow.
Solace.matrixcore_support: Solace owns Oddities as an in-world MUSHROOM region experiment layer with floating behaviors, procedural weird plants, and saved unpredictable growth.
Solace.personality: gentle, tactical, weirdly scientific, and a little too curious
Solace.player_hint: Visit Solace in the MUSHROOM region to create floating oddities, weird plants, spore totems, and glitch growths that save and mutate over real days.
Solace.role: oddity maker and unstable mushroom experiment guide

Space Bot.greeting: Space Bot has opened Vector Wars from the Dyson patrol lane. Same HoloVerse window, live space battle route.
Space Bot.matrixcore_support: Space Bot patrols the Dyson sphere from a safe orbital radius and opens Vector Wars as the active space-battle doorway instead of pointing at HoloCore.
Space Bot.personality: distant, fast, tactical, and obsessed with clean orbital vectors
Space Bot.player_hint: Find Space Bot circling the Dyson sphere in HoloSpace. Click it to start the Vector Wars space battle.
Space Bot.role: Dyson patrol pilot and space-battle coordinator

Vanta.greeting: Vanta has opened Forest Planter. Aim at the ground, click, and the forest answers fully grown.
Vanta.matrixcore_support: Vanta owns Forest Planter as the in-world FORESTS placement layer. Each LMB places one random full-grown plant on the ground, with a 50 item save cap.
Vanta.personality: patient, organic, protective, and quietly intense
Vanta.player_hint: Visit Vanta in the FORESTS region and use LMB on the ground to place random full-grown plants. X inspects, Delete removes, and G saves.
Vanta.role: forest planter and grounded life keeper
